name: LMR-Bench
description: LMR-Bench evaluates large language models' multi-step reasoning abilities across a set of structured reasoning problems, testing logical, mathematical, and chain-of-thought capabilities. It provides prompts and expected solutions to measure how well models can produce correct stepwise reasoning and final answers.
evaluation_method: accuracy / exact_match (often aggregated into a composite reasoning score)
general_score_metric: composite reasoning accuracy (task-dependent; often aggregated accuracy or exact match)
reputation: Community-contributed benchmark with moderate visibility among researchers studying reasoning and chain-of-thought; not a universally standardized suite.
